case_title: Raju @ Devendra Choubey v. State of Chhattisgarh
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Section 302 r/w Section 34 and Section 1208, IPC
neutral_facts: The prosecution case was that on 25.11.2003, the accused's husband returned home from a clinic and found a servant, aged 13 years, weeping. Upon entering the house, he discovered his daughter-in-law dead and his wife unconscious. The accused, who was the step mother-in-law of the deceased, had a domestic dispute with the deceased. The servant, who worked with the family, identified the accused persons in court. The servant stated that one accused caught the deceased and another attacked her with a knife 3-4 times. The incident occurred in the courtyard, with the accused present in the passage. The accused threatened the servant not to disclose the incident. The accused fled after the assault, and one of them took the servant to the terrace and instructed him to falsely accuse thieves. The prosecution examined 32 witnesses, and the trial court convicted all the accused under Section 302 r/w Section 34 and Section 1208, IPC. The High Court confirmed the conviction.
